newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Friday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers after a weekly movement of 104,600 head.
The last established price was $63.00 per cwt on Thursday.
Friday's packer bids were $61.00-$63.00, with asking prices $64.00-$66.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Last week - 200 Year Ago - 400
